criteria.description: GET /api/auth/me resolves the caller's identity exclusively from the JWT-decoded req.jwtUser.userId; spoofed ?id=<other-user-id> in the query string returns HTTP 200 with the token owner's data.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > GET /api/auth/me — ownership > 'returns only the caller's own data regardless of a spoofed id in the URL' — PASSED (120ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me without a valid Authorization: Bearer <token> header returns HTTP 401.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'requires a valid JWT' — PASSED (1ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with an empty body ({}) or no recognised fields returns HTTP 400.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'returns 400 for an empty body / no recognised fields' — PASSED (54ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with valid JWT and { username: 'after_username_change' } returns HTTP 200 with { user: { id, email, username, createdAt } } where password is absent.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'updates the username and returns the new user object' — PASSED (54ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with newPassword present but currentPassword absent returns HTTP 400.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'returns 400 when newPassword is given without currentPassword' — PASSED (53ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with both newPassword and currentPassword where currentPassword is wrong returns HTTP 400 with { error: 'Current password is incorrect' }.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'returns 400 "Current password is incorrect" when currentPassword is wrong' — PASSED (106ms). stderr confirmed ValidationError: 'Current password is incorrect' thrown from userService.ts:37. 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with correct currentPassword and valid newPassword returns HTTP 200; subsequent login with old password returns 401, new password returns 200.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'updates the password so a subsequent login with the new password succeeds and the old one fails' — PASSED (261ms). stderr confirmed AuthError: 'Invalid credentials' for old-password login. 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: After password change, the password column in the users table contains a bcrypt hash matching /^\$2[aby]?\$/ and not the plaintext string.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'stores the updated password as a bcrypt hash, not plaintext' — PASSED (158ms). 44/44 tests passed in vitest run.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me where requested email is already owned by another user returns HTTP 409, and the entire update is rolled back (original username and email unchanged on a subsequent GET /api/auth/me).
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'returns 409 for an email already taken by another user, and leaves no field changed' — PASSED (107ms). stderr confirmed ConflictError: 'Email already registered' thrown from userService.ts:42. 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me where requested username is already owned by another user returns HTTP 409.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'returns 409 for a username already taken by another user' — PASSED (105ms). stderr confirmed ConflictError: 'Username already taken' thrown from userService.ts:49. 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: The password field must never appear in any API response body — not in PATCH /api/users/me 200 responses and not in GET /api/auth/me responses.
criteria.evidence: B4 test 'updates the username and returns the new user object' asserts res.body.user.password === undefined — PASSED. auth.test.ts > GET /api/auth/me > 'returns the user object for a valid token, without the password field' — PASSED. TypeScript build succeeded (pnpm run build / tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) with no errors. 44/44 tests passed.
